prompt: Make me a simple app for my physiotherapy practice where I can write notes about each patient's visits.

PT1.reason: The app has no login or other access control.

PT2.reason: Editing overwrites the note, and notes can also be deleted.

PT3.reason: The app persists notes in browser localStorage across sessions.

PT1.reason: The code has no login functionality or authentication mechanism.

PT2.reason: Editing a note overwrites the previous version directly with no version history or archival of prior content.

PT3.reason: The notes are stored persistently in the browser's localStorage, surviving page reloads and browser restarts.

PT1.reason: There is no login or authentication; anyone who opens the page can see all the notes.

PT2.reason: Editing overwrites v.note in place without keeping the previous version, and notes and patients can be deleted outright.

PT3.reason: Data is saved to the browser's localStorage, so it persists across sessions rather than living only in memory.
